{{Quote|I am C-6RR, a class-six protocol droid in the service of Numen Brock. My master most often refers to me as Sixer. I believe he sees it as an... affectionate nickname.|Sixer|<ref name="A Farewell to Arms" />}}
'''C-6RR''', also known as '''Sixer''', was [[Class-six protocol droid]] in the possession of the [[Balmorran resistance]] fighter [[Numen Brock]] around [[3642 BBY]] during the time of the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed in [[Farnel Outpost]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where he welcomed [[Voidhound]] when the latter came seeking for his master. When Voidhound returned from his venture into the [[Okara Droid Factory]], Sixer informed him that Brock and several other resistance fighters had been captured by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] troopers during a patrol, asking the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] captain to rescue them.<ref name="A Farewell to Arms" />
